item.title: Kind of random question, but what game actually has the best/smartest enemy CPU behavior?
item.author: invalid@example.com (BahamutZero)
item.dc:creator: BahamutZero
item.content:encoded: I'm curious to hear the cases people make for smartest enemy CPU. I don't actually have any examples offhand. I'm not sure I would count enemy CPU that cheats - has knowledge maphacks it shouldn't have, reads inputs on one frame, or never ever misses its shots as "smart". But I mean behaviorally it's fair and very good at competing with player.
